tools.name: sec_browser
tools.summary: Load a page in a headless browser and return status, final URL, title, body text, and links. Runs on the host (the guest image has no browser) against the run's egress proxy, so scope still applies. Use it when a target needs JavaScript or
tools.how_to: page render via a host browser

tools.name: sec_crack
tools.summary: Crack a hash with hashcat (straight wordlist attack) and return the cracked plaintext. Requires hashcat installed and a wordlist.

tools.name: sec_dalfox
tools.summary: Run dalfox XSS scanner against a URL.

tools.name: sec_decode
tools.summary: Decode or transform a string through common CTF encodings: base64, base32, hex, URL-encoding, rot13, or gzip. Use operation='auto' (default) to try all methods and return every successful candidate labelled by method.

tools.name: sec_decrypt
tools.summary: Decrypt a blob with a key or password: AES-CBC/GCM/CTR with an explicit key or a password-derived key, or a single-byte/repeating-key XOR. Reports how the key was interpreted so a wrong guess is visible.

tools.name: sec_factor
tools.summary: Look up the factorization of an integer via the factordb.com API.

tools.name: sec_ffuf
tools.summary: Fuzz a URL with ffuf (URL must contain the FUZZ keyword).

tools.name: sec_hashid
tools.summary: Identify the likely type(s) of a hash string.

tools.name: sec_http
tools.summary: Perform a single HTTP request and return the status line, response headers, and body (body capped at 100 000 chars). TLS certificate verification is disabled, so self-signed certs are accepted.

tools.name: sec_jsdeobf
tools.summary: Deobfuscate/unpack JavaScript using webcrack (via npx). Accepts obfuscated JS source and returns the cleaned output.

tools.name: sec_lattice
tools.summary: LLL-reduce an integer lattice basis using fpylll.

tools.name: sec_nuclei
tools.summary: Run nuclei template-based vulnerability scan against a URL. Requires the `nuclei` binary to be installed and available in PATH.

tools.name: sec_pwntmpl
tools.summary: Generate a pwntools exploit skeleton via 'pwn template'. Optionally point it at a local binary or a remote host/port.

tools.name: sec_recording
tools.summary: Save or load a recording of HTTP requests. The recording is the fixed baseline for replay and for regression: save once, replay many times.

tools.name: sec_remote
tools.summary: Stateful pwntools TCP session. Use action='open' to connect, then send/sendline/recv to exchange data, and close when done.
tools.how_to: interactive pwn session; local without a host

tools.name: sec_replay
tools.summary: Re-send a saved recording against the target and report each response. The verification path for a proposed fix: run it against the patched target and compare with the baseline run.

tools.name: sec_rop
tools.summary: Search ROP gadgets in a binary with ROPgadget (optionally filtered by regex).

tools.name: sec_rsa
tools.summary: Run RsaCtfTool with the given CLI arguments (key files must live in the daemon working dir).

tools.name: sec_sourcemap
tools.summary: Parse a JavaScript source map and recover the original source files. Reads the 'sources' and 'sourcesContent' arrays from the .map JSON and returns either all recovered files (name + content) or a single entry selected by index.

tools.name: sec_sqlmap
tools.summary: Run sqlmap against a URL to detect/exploit SQL injection (batch mode). Returns combined stdout+stderr from the sqlmap process.
tools.how_to: fires injection payloads via the sqlmap binary

tools.name: sec_triage
tools.summary: Static triage of a local binary: file type, checksec mitigations, and one_gadget candidates. Read-only.

tools.name: sec_unmin
tools.summary: Beautify/un-minify JavaScript using jsbeautifier.

tools.name: sec_wasm
tools.summary: Decompile/disassemble a WebAssembly module using wabt (wasm-decompile or wasm2wat). Pass the .wasm bytes as base64.
tools.how_to: wabt binaries against a local module

tools.name: sec_xss
tools.summary: Probe a URL for reflected XSS. Returns `confirmed` when the injected marker comes back verbatim (would execute), `not_found` when it is absent or encoded, so a detector can tell a real fix from an escaping fix.

tools.name: sec_xss_confirm
tools.summary: Headless-browser confirmation of XSS: load a URL in Playwright Chromium and detect a fired javascript dialog (alert/confirm/prompt) or an injected DOM marker. The visual/DOM-XSS differentiator.

tools.name: sec_z3
tools.summary: Execute an agent-written Python Z3 (z3-solver) script and return its stdout. The general constraint-solving escape hatch.

tools.name: sec_zap
tools.summary: Drive a running OWASP ZAP daemon via its REST API (spider, active-scan, or list alerts).
